title: Reproducing Kar and Narasimhan 1987: interface states across the gap of thin unannealed oxides

sample.paper: “n- and p-type epitaxial silicon (Monsanto Company) with (100) surface orientation and 1.0-Ω cm layer resistivity”
sample.ours: FAMILY: Si_Planar; ORIENTATION: Si100; DOPING: n_type_1_ohm_cm_epi or p_type_1_ohm_cm_epi (recorded; no program reads it)

sample.paper: degrease, ultrasonic, acid etch, then a sacrificial 1100 °C dry oxide stripped in HF: “Preoxidation was part of the surface cleaning.”
sample.ours: CLEAN: not_stated; the steps as events
sample.note: The vocabulary has no clean for a sacrificial oxide and HF strip.

sample.paper: n-Si: semitransparent Au front (~100 Å), Al back; p-Si: Al front, Au back; 0.5 mm dots
sample.note: Gate metal differs between the n and p series.

sample.paper: “The oxide thickness varied between 79 and 227 Å.”; method not stated
“Sample fabrication was carried out in a class 100 clean environment.”

history.item: Degreased in hot solvents, ultrasonic clean, acid etch
history.paper: “After degreasing in hot solvents, ultrasonic cleaning, and etching in acids,”
history.ours: CLEAN: not_stated (no word in the vocabulary for this sequence)

history.item: Sacrificial oxidation, dry O2, 1100 °C, 30 min, Thermco furnace
history.paper: “preoxidation was carried out in dry O2 at 1100 °C at 1 atm in a Thermco resistance-heated furnace for 30 min.”
history.note: Written as an event because the oxide is stripped next and the language cannot remove oxide; a RUN would leave about 70 nm under the gate oxide in every growth program. Its heat (30 min at 1100 °C) reaches the wafer.

history.item: Preoxide etched in HF, ultrasonic clean, rinse in 14-18 MΩ cm water, dry in filtered N2
history.paper: “Subsequently, the wafers were etched in HF, ultrasonically cleaned, rinsed in 14-18 MΩ cm deionized water, and dried in filtered N2 gas. Preoxidation was part of the surface cleaning.”

history.item: Wafer heats to 900 °C during the push (assumed: 5 min, nitrogen, settling)
history.ours: RUN Push DURATION 300 TEMP 25->900 AMBIENT inert_N2 PROFILE settling TAU 60
history.note: The paper describes no push or warm-up. Ours: 5 min, PROFILE settling with TAU 60 s, in nitrogen. Nitrogen because the trap-density program takes the oxidation temperature from the first oxygen step's start temperature; the gas is not stated (see the variant).

history.paper: “Final oxidation was carried out in dry O2 at 900 °C at 1 atm.”; “All the samples underwent identical processing steps and processing sequence, except the final oxidation time which was varied.”; time on the axis of Figure 1
history.ours: RUN Oxidation DURATION 1200 TEMP 900->900 AMBIENT dry_O2

history.item: Pulled out of the hot zone in 6 s, in oxygen (temperature path ours: 900 → 800 °C)
history.paper: “At the end of the oxidation, the wafer was pulled out of the furnace in 6 s”
history.ours: RUN Pull DURATION 6 TEMP 900->800 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: 6 s is stated; where the wafer's temperature is at the end of it is ours.

history.item: Cooled in the silica tube in dry oxygen (assumed: 15 min to room temperature, settling)
history.paper: “and was allowed to cool in the silica tube in a dry oxygen ambient.”
history.ours: RUN TubeCool DURATION 900 TEMP 800->25 AMBIENT dry_O2 PROFILE settling TAU 180
history.note: Gas and place stated; time and rate not. TAU 180 s is ours.

history.paper: “No post-oxidation or post-metallization annealing was carried out in this phase of the study in order to preserve all the features in the interface state density profile”

history.item: Optical MOS admittance, dark and under tungsten-lamp light, 30 Hz-100 kHz
history.paper: “Admittance-voltage measurements were made in the dark as well as under illumination, over the frequency range of 30 Hz-100 kHz”
history.ours: the observables Dit (midgap) and, where hydrogen was used, Dit at fixed energies
history.note: Capacitance and conductance techniques agree within 3-22% (PDF p. 4).

history.paper: not stated; Figure 1 gives thickness against time, Figures 3 and 4 give devices by thickness
history.ours: the Figure 1(b) time at the device's thickness (ours)

history.paper: “No post-oxidation or post-metallization annealing was carried out”
history.ours: no RUN after the cool; EVENT NoAnneal
history.note: So the predictor writes no spectrum rows and the Quantum ESPRESSO hydrogen bound does not apply.
